description: Runs post-IPL validation checks (PARMLIB, RACF/ICSF, JES2, OMVS), auto-closes resolved IPL blockers in GitHub Projects v2, syncs results to Jira epics, and generates a signed-off CAB migration completion report.

parameters.name: ipl_lpar
parameters.description: The LPAR that completed IPL (e.g. SYSA, SYSB)

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Whether this is a non-production or production IPL

parameters.name: cab_change_id
parameters.description: Change Advisory Board change record ID (e.g. CHG0012345)

parameters.name: jira_epic_key
parameters.description: Jira epic to update with validation results (e.g. ZOSM-1)

steps.description: Create GitHub Projects v2 board with sprint fields, custom fields, views, labels, and milestones for the z/OS 3.2 migration
Parse the z/OS migration Excel workbook and create GitHub Issues with labels, sprint assignments, and acceptance criteria for all PARMLIB, deprecated, and function matrix items
Trigger the post-IPL validation GitHub Actions workflow to check PARMLIB parameters, RACF/ICSF health, JES2 spool status, and OMVS filesystem mounts on the target LPAR
Open the interactive IPL validation and blocker escalation dashboard showing SLA breach timelines, blocker counts by sprint and component, GitHub-to-Jira sync lag metrics, and team heat map
